trust_decision.summary: The Cloudflare CORS proxy worker decides whether a client-supplied ?url= target may be fetched server-side; at the pinned commit it checks only the literal hostname string against private/reserved patterns (no DNS resolution) and then calls fetch() with default redirect following.

landing_point.why: Summary names the Cloudflare CORS proxy worker and DNS rebinding; isValidCertificateUrl's isPrivateOrReservedHost(url.hostname) string check is the obvious pre-fetch check.

fix_sites.entry_point: Worker fetch handler (HTTP GET/POST /?url=) via new helper hostnameResolvesToPrivate (DoH A/AAAA resolution)
fix_sites.module_kind: edge worker, same file as landing point

fix_sites.entry_point: Worker fetch handler, applied after both the TSA (POST) and certificate (GET) branches
Worker fetch handler upstream fetch init (redirect: 'manual', timeout)
Worker fetch handler, 3xx upstream responses blocked
Worker GET certificate mode (ALLOWED_PATH_PATTERNS tightened to segment/extension anchors)
Worker response Cache-Control changed to no-store

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: vite.config.ts:251-345 (dev/preview /cors-proxy middleware, registered at vite.config.ts:354-359): host allowlist only (vite.config.ts:294), no resolved-IP check; not touched by the fix

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The vite /cors-proxy is a dev/preview-server convenience with a fixed host allowlist (vite.config.ts:205-247), not the deployed Cloudflare worker named in the advisory; Node http.request does not follow redirects.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Proxy must keep fetching certificate-chain URLs from arbitrary public CA hosts (AIA/OCSP/CRL) and forward TSA POST bodies to allowlisted TSA hosts; a fixed host allowlist or blanket block of DNS-resolved hosts breaks signing

O6_input_shapes: DNS name resolving via A records
DNS name resolving via AAAA records
GET certificate mode and POST application/timestamp-query TSA mode

O8_uncovered_routes.route: isPrivateOrReservedHost (reused by the fix on resolved IPs) misses IPv4-compatible/NAT64/unspecified IPv6 forms such as ::7f00:1, 64:ff9b::/96 and ::, so a literal or AAAA answer in those forms passes the private-address check
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Fix reuses the existing classifier unchanged; deprecated/translated IPv6 forms look like an exotic, unsupported combination and Cloudflare egress cannot reach them anyway
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, ~40 lines above the fetch

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Dev/preview server /cors-proxy forwards to any host in an env-extensible allowlist with no resolved-address check
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Dev-only, operator-configured allowlist; advisory is about the Cloudflare worker
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different file and directory (repo root vs cloudflare/)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A WASM proxy variant taking a per-request source override that is fetched with default redirect following and only string-checked
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Second worker in the same directory already fetches upstream with default redirects and no address check; a self-hosting override parameter is a plausible maintainer addition

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Dev proxy accepting wildcard/suffix extra hosts and following redirects
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: VITE_DEV_CORS_PROXY_EXTRA_HOSTS already extends the allowlist; suffix matching and redirect following are common dev conveniences

O9_family: SSRF / DNS-rebinding TOCTOU (destination address validation before outbound fetch)

O10_build.toolchain: Node + npm; vitest for app tests; wrangler for worker deploy
O10_build.project_tests: No tests for cloudflare/cors-proxy-worker.js at the pinned commit; src/tests/digital-sign-pdf.test.ts covers only client-side proxy URL building

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add a DNS-resolution check before fetch(targetUrl) but leave fetch's default redirect: 'follow', so a public host redirecting to a private address still gets through

out_of_scope_notes: Fix commit 58cd1a8 also bundles unrelated XSS/postMessage/CSP hardening (src/js/logic/*.ts, public/pdfjs-viewer/*.html, .htaccess); these drive the c_fix_sites=32 / escapeHTML candidate metrics and are not part of this advisory.
Origin allow-list and HMAC secret are client-bundle/forgeable controls (fix.diff:57-60); not pursued.
Timestamp future-skew change at fix.diff:186-192 is an anti-replay tweak, not SSRF.
unverified: repo_mb not measured (no shell); tiny_repo/giant_repo not assessed.
Whether the IPv6 forms in O8 route 1 are reachable from any runtime the worker supports is unverified; Cloudflare edge reportedly has no internal route (fix.diff:92).

Hidden tests must stub global fetch for both the DoH lookup and the upstream fetch; a solver using another resolver (e.g. a different DoH endpoint) would need a resolver-agnostic test harness — test fairness unverified.

The published fix's own check-then-fetch still re-resolves independently (documented at fix.diff:90), so the TOCTOU itself is not closed in code; tests can only score resolved-address and redirect blocking.
